meta.scope: Iraq Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Central Statistical Organization, population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank of Iraq institutional core, BOP. Population ~47–48 million. Oil-dominated fiscal and external structure.

candidates.title: Central Statistical Organization (Iraq) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Iraqi statistical system.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and estimates. Population is approximately 47–48 million; the age structure is young and urbanisation is advancing.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Iraq (GDP)
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy is heavily oil-dominated; non-oil activity and public-sector employment are central to domestic absorption.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Oil share is structurally dominant.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been relatively moderate in recent periods compared with some regional peers, but remains sensitive to exchange-rate and supply conditions.

candidates.title: Central Bank of Iraq institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, reserve management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.
candidates.notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to the statistical office.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Oil exports dominate the current account; reserve management and FX windows are central policy instruments.

candidates.title: Iraq foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBI institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Iraqi research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Iraqi research. Oil dominance will structure subsequent densification.
